# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights Concluded (§ 8–11) & Situation Two Heading

## Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα: Ἑσπερινός, Ὄρθρος καὶ Λειτουργία [Violakis, p. 318]

Στιχηρά, *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Σήμερον ἡ κτίσις φωτίζεται* (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, καὶ τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

9.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον δίς, καὶ τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* ἅπαξ, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων [Ὁ Βιολάκης παραλείπει τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, τὴν Ὑπακοήν, τοὺς Ἀναβαθμοὺς καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τοῦ ἤχου]. Οἱ Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ α΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ προεόρτιον Κάθισμα, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον. Καταβασίαι, *Στείβει θαλάσσης*, καὶ ἡ πᾶσα τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, *Δόξα*, τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

10.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς ἑορτῆς εἰς δ΄. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον *Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

11.    Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς τελεῖται κατὰ τὸ ἑπόμενον Σάββατον, καθ’ ὃν τρόπον ἐτελέσθη ἡ ἑορτή, ἄνευ τῶν Ἀναγνωσμάτων ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, καὶ ἄνευ τῆς Λιτῆς, τοῦ Πολυελέου καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ· ἐν δὲ τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ λέγεται ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Σαββάτου μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα.

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights Concluded (§ 8–11) & Situation Two Heading

## Sunday after the Lights: Vespers, Matins, Liturgy, and Apodosis [Violakis, p. 319]

...Stichira; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"Today creation is illumined"** (*Σήμερον ἡ κτίσις φωτίζεται*, seek in the Lite). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, and **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and Dismissal.

9.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion (twice), and **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (once); the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia [the editio princeps of Violakis inadvertently omits the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon]. The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and the First Canon of the Feast with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*). After the Third Ode, the pre-festal Kathisma; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the day. Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the entire order of the Resurrectional Morning Gospel. The Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast; **"Glory"**: the appointed Resurrectional Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

10.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes of the Tone for 4 troparia, and 4 from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Feast. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Holy Patron of the Temple; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); the Epistle [Ephesians 4:7–13] and the Gospel [Matthew 4:12–17] of the Sunday after the Lights. At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*). Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

11.    The Apodosis of the Feast is celebrated on the following Saturday [January 14] in the same manner as the Feast itself was celebrated, omitting the Old Testament Readings at Vespers, and without the Lite, the Polyeleos, or the Gospel at Matins; at the Divine Liturgy, the Epistle [Colossians 1:3–6] and the Gospel [Luke 16:10–15] of the Saturday after the Lights are read.

# Month of January: Situation Two (Theophany on Saturday) (§ 12–15)

## Situation Two: Paramony, Theophany, and Sunday after the Lights [Violakis, p. 321]

12.    On Friday morning: the Great Hours are chanted according to the rubrics of § 1 of the Eve of the Nativity of Christ; and in the evening Great Vespers joined to the Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil the Great with the Blessing of the Waters, as in § 2.

13.    On Saturday, the Feast of Holy Theophany: Matins, the Blessing of the Waters, and the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom, as in § 3.

14.    On that same Saturday evening: after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), 10 Stichira: 4 Resurrectional, 3 of the Feast: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*), and 3 of the Forerunner: **"O most praised Forerunner of Christ"** (*Πανεύφημε Πρόδρομε Χριστοῦ*); **"Glory"**: **"O torch incarnate"** (*Ἔνσαρκε λύχνε*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"God the Word appeared in the flesh"** (*Θεὸς λόγος ἐπεφάνη ἐν σαρκί*). Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Great Prokeimenon in Tone 7: **"Our God is in heaven and on earth; all things whatsoever He hath willed, He hath done"** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ, πάντα ὅσα ἠθέλησεν ἐποίησεν*, Ps. 113:11 LXX) with its verses. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory"**: **"As a lover of the Spirit"** (*Ὡς τοῦ Πνεύματος ἐραστής*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Come, let us imitate the wise virgins"** (*Δεῦτε μιμησώμεθα*); Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forerunner: **"The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise"** (*Μνήμη δικαίου μετ’ ἐγκωμίων*), and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and Dismissal.

15.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Forerunner, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata, and one each of the Feast: **"When Jesus was born"** (*Τοῦ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος*) and **"When he saw Thee in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις βλέψας σε τοῦ Ἰορδάνου*); the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, the Canon of the Feast with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*), and that of the Forerunner with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"** (*Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*). After the Third Ode: the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Kathismata of the Forerunner: **"The great rain"** (*Ὁ μέγας ὑετός*) and **"Willingly He came forth upon earth"** (*Ἑκὼν προῆλθεν ἐπὶ γῆς*); after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, and the Menologion of the day. Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; then the Ninth Ode is sung with the Megalynaria of the Feast: **"Every tongue is at a loss to praise Thee worthily"** (*Ἀπορεῖ πᾶσα γλῶσσα*), and that of the Forerunner with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"**...[^227]

*(Printed Page 321)*

=== LEAF p337 ===

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights Concluded (§ 15–16) & Apodosis Opening (§ 17–18)

## Θεία Λειτουργία καὶ Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς ἐν Κυριακῇ: Ἑσπερινὸς καὶ Ὄρθρος [Violakis, p. 322]

Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Φῶς ἐκ φωτὸς* δ΄, *Δόξα*, *Ἄγγελος ἐκ στειρωτικῶν ὠδίνων*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

16.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς χθές, μετὰ τοῦ Στίχου τοῦ β΄ Ἀντιφώνου *Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*. Εἰσοδικὸν *Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*. Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Προδρόμου *Μνήμη δικαίου* καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* [τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ παραλείπεται ἐδῶ· βλέπε § 39 τῆς Προθεωρίας], Κοντάκιον *Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*, ἀντὶ τοῦ Τρισαγίου *Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, *Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*. Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

*[Σημ. 2. 2. Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα ἀναγινώσκονται εἰς τὴν Ἀπόδοσιν τῆς ἑορτῆς (14 Ἰανουαρίου). Ἐὰν ὅμως ἡ 14 Ἰανουαρίου τύχῃ ἡ Κυριακὴ τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ Φαρισαίου, τότε τῇ 7 Ἰανουαρίου ἀναγινώσκεται ὁ μὲν Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Προδρόμου, τὸ δὲ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα.]*

17.    Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς τελεῖται τῇ ἑπομένῃ Κυριακῇ (14 Ἰανουαρίου). Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν* ς΄, *Δόξα*, *Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*, *Καὶ νῦν*, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον*, Ἀπολυτίκιον τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* δίς, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

18.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον,

*(Printed Page 322)*

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights Concluded (§ 15–16) & Apodosis Opening (§ 17–18)

## Divine Liturgy and Apodosis of the Feast on Sunday: Vespers and Matins [Violakis, p. 323]

...Exapostilaria of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, and of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Feast: **"Light from Light"** (*Φῶς ἐκ φωτός*); **"Glory"**: **"An angel from barren pangs"** (*Ἄγγελος ἐκ στειρωτικῶν ὠδίνων*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

16.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast as yesterday, with the verse of the Second Antiphon: **"Who wast baptized by John in the Jordan"** (*Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου βαπτισθείς*). Introit: **"Come, let us worship and bow down before Christ. Save us, O Son of God, Who art risen from the dead..."** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν καὶ προσπέσωμεν Χριστῷ. Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν...*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forerunner: **"The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise"** (*Μνήμη δικαίου μετ’ ἐγκωμίων*), and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*) [the Dismissal Troparion of the Holy Patron of the Temple is omitted here in Violakis, but see § 39 of the Protheoria]; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); instead of the Trisagion Hymn: **"All of you who have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia"** (*Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε, Χριστὸν ἐνεδύσασθε. Ἀλληλούϊα*, Galatians 3:27); the Epistle [Acts 19:1–8] and the Gospel [John 1:29–34] of the Forerunner. At **"Especially"**: **"Magnify, O my soul... O the marvels surpassing understanding"** (*Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου... Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*). Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and Dismissal.

*[Note 2: Under normal conditions, the Epistle and the Gospel of the Sunday after the Lights are read on the Apodosis of the Feast (January 14). If, however, January 14 happens to be the Sunday of the Publican and Pharisee, then on January 7 the Epistle of the Forerunner is read, and the Gospel of the Sunday after the Lights is proclaimed.]*

17.    The Apodosis of the Feast is celebrated on the following Sunday (January 14). On Saturday evening: after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and Kathisma 1 of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 6 of the Feast: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*); **"Glory"**: **"Thou hast bowed Thy head unto the Forerunner"** (*Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*); **"Both now and ever"**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day: **"The Lord is King, He is clothed with majesty"** (*Ὁ Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν*, Ps. 92:1 LXX). At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"The Sun born of a virgin"** (*Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον*); Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (twice), and Dismissal.

18.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon...[^228]

*(Printed Page 323)*

# Month of January: Apodosis Concluded (§ 18–19) & Situation Three (Theophany on Sunday) (§ 20–22)

## Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς ἐν Κυριακῇ: Κατακλεὶς καὶ Ἑορτὴ ἐν Κυριακῇ [Violakis, p. 324]

οἱ Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ἀμφότεροι τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ὅτε τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ σου*, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον. Καταβασίαι διπλαῖ, καὶ τὸ Ἑωθινὸν Εὐαγγέλιον, αἱ Θ΄ Ὠδαὶ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν Κανόνων μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Φῶς ἐκ φωτὸς* δ΄, *Δόξα*, *Νάματα Ἰορδάνεια*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

19.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα ὡς ἐν § 16, μετὰ τοῦ Στίχου τοῦ β΄ Ἀντιφώνου *Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*. Εἰσοδικὸν μετὰ τοῦ *Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*. Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῆς ἑορτῆς [τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ παραλείπεται ἐδῶ· βλέπε § 39 τῆς Προθεωρίας], Κοντάκιον *Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα (ἐπειδὴ κατὰ τὴν παρελθοῦσαν Κυριακὴν ἀνεγνώσθησαν τὰ τοῦ Προδρόμου). Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, *Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*. Κοινωνικὸν *Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ*, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Γ΄. Ὅταν ἡ ἑορτὴ τύχῃ ἐν Κυριακῇ.

20.    Τῇ Παρασκευῇ πρωῒ ψάλλονται μόνον αἱ Μεγάλαι Ὧραι μετὰ τοῦ Τροπαρίου *Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν* καὶ τοῦ Κοντακίου *Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*· μετὰ δὲ τὴν Εὐχὴν τῆς Θ΄ Ὥρας γίνεται Ἀπόλυσις. Ἐν δὲ τῇ τραπέζῃ κατάλυσις εἰς πάντα (ἄνευ νηστείας), καθότι ἡ νηστεία τῆς Παραμονῆς μετατίθεται εἰς τὸ Σάββατον.

21.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας ψάλλεται ὁ προεόρτιος Ἑσπερινὸς κατὰ τὸ Μηναῖον· μετὰ δὲ τὸ *Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, ψάλλεται ὁ Κανών, καὶ μετὰ τὴν θ΄ Ὠδὴν τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

22.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Μεσονυκτικόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον, οἱ Κανόνες τοῦ Μηναίου, προεόρτιος καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων,

*(Printed Page 324)*

# Month of January: Apodosis Concluded (§ 18–19) & Situation Three (Theophany on Sunday) (§ 20–22)

## Apodosis on Sunday Concluded and Situation Three (Theophany on Sunday) [Violakis, p. 325]

...The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and both Canons of the Feast with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*). After the Third Ode, the Hypakoe of the Feast: **"When at Thy manifestation"** (*Ὅτε τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ σου*); after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the day. Both double Katavasiai: **"He uncovered the bottom of the deep"** (*Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα*) and **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; the Ninth Odes of both Canons are sung with their Megalynaria. Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion and that of the Feast (twice). At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Feast: **"Light from Light"** (*Φῶς ἐκ φωτός*); **"Glory"**: **"O Savior, Who clothedst Thyself with the waters of Jordan"** (*Νάματα Ἰορδάνεια*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

19.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast as in § 16, with the verse of the Second Antiphon: **"Who wast baptized by John in the Jordan"** (*Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*). Introit of the Feast with **"Who art risen from the dead"** (*Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** [the Dismissal Troparion of the Holy Patron of the Temple is omitted here in Violakis, but see § 39 of the Protheoria]; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); the Trisagion Hymn; the Epistle [Ephesians 4:7–13] and the Gospel [Matthew 4:12–17] of the Sunday after the Lights (since on the preceding Sunday the lections of the Forerunner were proclaimed). At **"Especially"**: **"Magnify, O my soul... O the marvels surpassing understanding"** (*Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου... Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*). Communion Verse: **"The grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared unto all men"** (*Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡ σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις*, Titus 2:11); **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and Dismissal.

## Situation Three: When the Feast Falls on a Sunday

20.    On Friday morning: only the Great Hours are chanted, with the Troparion: **"Make ready, O Zebulun"** (*Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλών*) and the Kontakion: **"Today the Lord hath appeared in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*); after the Prayer of the Ninth Hour, the Dismissal takes place. At table, dispensation for all foods [without fasting] is observed, because the strict fast of the Paramony is transferred to Saturday.

21.    On that same Friday evening: Forefeast Vespers is sung according to the Menaion; after **"Lord, now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29–32), the Canon is sung, and after the Ninth Ode, the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"The river Jordan once turned back"** (*Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε*), and Dismissal.

22.    On Saturday at Matins: after the Midnight Service, the Psalter Kathismata, the Canons from the Menaion (the Forefeast Canon and that of the Saints)...[^229]

*(Printed Page 325)*

# Month of January: Situation Three Concluded (§ 22–26) & Sunday after the Lights Opening (§ 27)

## Ἑορτὴ ἐν Κυριακῇ: Κατακλεὶς καὶ Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα [Violakis, p. 326]

ἀναγινώσκονται χῦμα τὰ Καθίσματα, ὁ Προεόρτιος Κανὼν καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἶτα ψάλλονται αἱ Καταβασίαι *Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάληψε πυθμένα* [ἀνεκάληψε *sic*], καὶ ἀκολούθως στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν* καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἐξαποστειλάριον δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ δ΄ τῆς ἡμέρας Προσόμοια *Τί ἀμφιγνοεῖς Βαπτιστὰ οἰκονομίαν;* *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Ἰωάννη Βαπτιστα* (ζήτει εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῶν Αἴνων), Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε*.

23.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, *Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*, τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Σαββάτου πρὸ τῶν Φώτων. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὸ *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*. Μετὰ τὸ *Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, ψάλλονται τὰ Ἰδιόμελα τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ *Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων* κτλ. καὶ τελεῖται ὁ Ἁγιασμὸς κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν. Ἐν τῇ τραπέζῃ κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου.

24.    Τῷ αὐτῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, ψάλλεται ὁ Μ. τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἑσπερινός, ἐν ᾧ οὐδὲν τῶν Ἀναστασίμων ψάλλομεν, ἀλλ’ ἅπαντα τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς ἑξῆς· Μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, ψάλλομεν τὰ Ἰδιόμελα *Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν* εἰς ς΄. *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*. Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα μετὰ τῶν Τροπαρίων καὶ τῶν Στίχων αὐτῶν, ὁ Ἀπόστολος, τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον καὶ τὰ λοιπά, ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἰδιόμελα *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἰδών σε ὁ Ἰωάννης* καὶ τὰ ἕτερα δύο, *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον*, *Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

25.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ ψάλλεται ἡ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου, ὁ Μ. Ἁγιασμός, ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου, ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 3-4.

26.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Κυριακῇ ἑσπέρας καὶ τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωῒ ψάλλεται ἡ ἀκολουθία τοῦ τιμίου Προδρόμου, ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 5, 6, 7. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου, Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς μνημόσυνον*.

### Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα.

At the Praises: the 4 Prosomia of the day: **"Why dost thou hesitate, O Baptist, to accomplish this dispensation?"** (*Τί ἀμφιγνοεῖς, Βαπτιστά, τὴν οἰκονομίαν;*); **"Glory... At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Communion Verse of the day, and **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*). After **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*), the Idiomela of the Blessing of the Waters are sung: **"The voice of the Lord is upon the waters"** (*Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων*), etc., and the Blessing of the Waters is performed according to the order in the Menaion. At table, dispensation for wine and oil is permitted.

24. Both now and ever..."**: **"Thou didst bow Thy head to the Forerunner"** (*Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*). Entrance with the Gospel Book, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Old Testament Readings with their Troparia and their verses; the Epistle, the Gospel, and the rest, as appointed in Situation One, § 2. At the Aposticha: the Idiomela: **"When John saw Thee in the river Jordan, O Christ God"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἰδών σε ὁ Ἰωάννης*) and the other two; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"The Sun born of a Virgin"** (*Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον*); **"Lord, now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29–32); the Trisagion Prayers; the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*) thrice, and Dismissal.

25.    On Sunday: the festal Matins office, the Great Blessing of the Waters, and the Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil the Great are celebrated, as appointed in Situation One, § 3–4.

26.    On that same Sunday evening and on Monday morning: the office of the Honorable Forerunner is chanted, as appointed in Situation One, § 5, 6, and 7. The Epistle [Acts 19:1–8] and the Gospel [John 1:29–34] of the Forerunner; Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX).

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights Concluded (§ 27–28) & Situation Four (Theophany on Monday) (§ 29–33)

## Ἀπόδοσις καὶ Ἑορτὴ ἐν Δευτέρᾳ [Violakis, p. 328]

συμπίπτει τῇ ΙΓ΄ τοῦ μηνός, ψάλλεται δὲ ἡ Ἀκολουθία ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 8, 9, 10.

### Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις.

28.    Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις συμπίπτει τῇ ἐπιούσῃ ἡμέρᾳ Δευτέρᾳ (ΙΔ΄ τοῦ μηνός), ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται ἅπαντα τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ὡς προδιετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 11. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον λέγονται τῆς ἡμέρας, Κοινωνικὸν *Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις*, *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Δ΄. Ὅταν ἡ ἑορτὴ τύχῃ ἐν Δευτέρᾳ.

29.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ ἐν Δευτέρᾳ, τῇ Παρασκευῇ πρωῒ (Γ΄ τοῦ μηνός), μετὰ τὴν τοῦ Ὄρθρου ἐνδιάτακτον Ἀκολουθίαν, ψάλλονται αἱ Μ. Ὧραι μόναι καὶ λέγεται Τροπάριον *Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν* καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*· μετὰ τὴν Εὐχὴν τῆς Θ΄ Ὥρας Ἀπόλυσις.

30.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας, ψάλλεται ὁ Προεόρτιος Ἑσπερινὸς κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν· μετὰ τὸ *Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, ὁ Προεόρτιος τοῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ Κανών, ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς Θ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

31.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Μεσονυκτικὸν κτλ. εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν* δίς, Κανόνες ὁ Προεόρτιος *Ὡς ἐν ἠπείρῳ πεζεύσας* καὶ ὁ τῶν Ο΄ Ἀποστόλων *Χριστῷ μαθητεύσαντες* (ζήτει τῇ Δ΄ τοῦ μηνός), ἀφ’ ς΄, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος, τὰ Προεόρτια καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· εἶτα ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῶν Ο΄ *Καταλιπόντες κόσμον* καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον *Ὁ ἐκ Πατρὸς ἀχρόνως*, οἱ Αἶνοι τὸ *Σοὶ Δόξα, πρέπει* καὶ τὰ Ἀπόστιχα. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Σαββάτου πρὸ τῶν Φώτων, Κοινωνικὸν *Μακάριοι οὓς ἐξελέξω*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

32.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, καὶ τῇ Κυριακῇ πρωῒ ψάλλεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῶν Φώτων μετὰ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου καὶ τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ, ὡς διετυπώθη ἐν περιπτώσει Β § 4, 5, 6. Ἐν τῇ τραπέζῃ κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου.

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights Concluded (§ 27–28) & Situation Four (Theophany on Monday) (§ 29–33)

## Sunday after the Lights Concluded, Apodosis, and Situation Four [Violakis, p. 329]

...falls on the 13th of the month; and the office is chanted as appointed in Situation One, § 8, 9, and 10.

### The Apodosis

28.    The Apodosis falls on the following day, Monday (the 14th of the month), on which all the services of the Feast are chanted, as previously appointed in Situation One, § 11. The Epistle and the Gospel of the day are read; Communion Verse: **"The grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared unto all men"** (*Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ*, Titus 2:11); **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and Dismissal.

## Situation Four: When the Feast Falls on a Monday

29.    If the Feast of Holy Theophany falls on a Monday: on Friday morning (the 3rd of the month), after the appointed Matins office, only the Great Royal Hours are chanted, and the Troparion: **"Make ready, O Zebulun"** (*Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλών*) and the Kontakion: **"Today the Lord hath appeared in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*) are said; after the Prayer of the Ninth Hour, the Dismissal takes place.

30.    On that same Friday evening: Forefeast Vespers is chanted according to the order of the Menaion; after **"Lord, now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29–32), the Forefeast Canon of Vespers is chanted, and after the Heirmos of the Ninth Ode, the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"Make ready, O Zebulun"** (*Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλών*), and Dismissal.

31.    On Saturday at Matins: after the Midnight Service, etc., at **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*), the Dismissal Troparion: **"Make ready, O Zebulun"** (twice); Canons: the Forefeast Canon: **"Traversing the deep on foot as on dry land"** (*Ὡς ἐν ἠπείρῳ πεζεύσας*) and that of the Seventy Apostles: **"Having been discipled unto Christ"** (*Χριστῷ μαθητεύσαντες*, seek on the 4th of the month); after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forefeast, and the Menologion of the Saints of the day; then the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode, and we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilarion of the Seventy Apostles: **"Having forsaken the world"** (*Καταλιπόντες κόσμον*) and the Forefeast Exapostilarion: **"Begotten timelessly of the Father"** (*Ὁ ἐκ Πατρὸς ἀχρόνως*); at the Praises: **"To Thee belongeth glory"** (*Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει*), and the Aposticha. At the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle [1 Timothy 3:14–4:5] and the Gospel [Matthew 3:1–11] of the Saturday before the Lights [Epiphany]; Communion Verse: **"Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken unto Thyself, O Lord"** (*Μακάριοι οὓς ἐξελέξω καὶ προσελάβου, Κύριε*, Ps. 64:5 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

32.    On Saturday evening and Sunday morning: the office of the Sunday before the Lights [Epiphany] is chanted, together with the Divine Liturgy of Saint John Chrysostom and the Blessing of the Waters, as formulated in Situation Two, § 4, 5, and 6. At table, dispensation for wine and oil is permitted.

33.    On that same Sunday evening: Great Vespers is chanted with the Old Testament Readings, the Troparia and their verses, the Epistle...[^231]

# Month of January: Situation Four Concluded (§ 33–36), Situation Five (§ 37) & St. Theodosios Heading

## Ἑορτὴ ἐν Δευτέρᾳ Κατακλεὶς καὶ Ἑορτὴ ἐν Τρίτῃ, Τετάρτῃ, ἢ Πέμπτῃ [Violakis, p. 330]

Ἀποστόλου, τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, τῶν Ἀποστίχων καὶ λοιπῶν, ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Γ΄ § 24.

34.    Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ ψάλλεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τοῦ Μ. Ἁγιασμοῦ καὶ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου, ὡς εἴρηται ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 3, 4.

35.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Δευτέρᾳ ἑσπέρας καὶ τῇ Τρίτῃ πρωῒ ψάλλεται ἡ ἀκολουθία τοῦ τιμίου Προδρόμου, ὡς διετυπώθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 5, 6, 7.

### Ἡ Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα.

36.    Ἡ Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα συμπίπτει κατὰ τὴν Δ΄ ταύτην περίπτωσιν τῇ ΙΒ΄ τοῦ μηνὸς καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ καὶ τῷ Ὄρθρῳ, ὡς διετυπώθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 8, 9, 10.
       Ἡ δὲ Ἀπόδοσις κατὰ τὴν περίστασιν ταύτην συμπίπτει τῇ Τρίτῃ τῆς προσεχοῦς ἑβδομάδος, καθ’ ἣν ψάλλονται, ὡς προερρήθη ἐν § 11, ἅπαντα τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἡμέρας.

### Ε΄. Ὅταν ἡ ἑορτὴ τύχῃ ἐν Τρίτῃ, Τετάρτῃ, ἢ Πέμπτῃ.

37.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ ἐν Τρίτῃ, Τετάρτῃ, ἢ Πέμπτῃ, τὴν διάταξιν τῆς Ἀκολουθίας τῶν Μ. Ὡρῶν, ἐν τῇ Παραμονῇ, τοῦ Μ. Ἑσπερινοῦ, τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου καὶ τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ, ὅρα ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 1, 2. Τῆς δὲ κυρίας ἡμέρας τὴν τῆς Ἀκολουθίας τοῦ Ὄρθρου, τοῦ Μ. Ἁγιασμοῦ καὶ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου διάταξιν ὅρα ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 3, 4.
       Τὴν διάταξιν τῆς Ἀκολουθίας τοῦ τιμίου Προδρόμου τῇ ἐπιούσῃ ἡμέρᾳ, ὅρα ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ Α΄ περιπτώσει § 5, 6, 7. Ἡ δὲ Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα, κατὰ τὴν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Τρίτῃ σύμπτωσιν τῆς ἑορτῆς, συμπίπτει τῇ ΙΑ΄ τοῦ μηνός, καθ’ ἣν ἑορτάζεται καὶ ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ὁσίου Θεοδοσίου τοῦ Κοινοβιάρχου. Τούτου ἡ Ἀκολουθία συμψάλλεται τῇ τῆς Κυριακῆς κατὰ τὴν ἐν § 39 διάταξιν.

# Month of January: St. Theodosios the Cenobiarch Concurrence (§ 38–41)

## Τοῦ Ὁσίου Θεοδοσίου τοῦ Κοινοβιάρχου [Violakis, p. 332]

38.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ὁσίου ἐν ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν διάταξιν τοῦ Μηναίου· ἂν δὲ συμπέσῃ ἐν Σαββάτῳ, Ἀπόστολος λέγεται τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον Σαββάτου μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα.

39.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, μεθέορτα γ΄ *Εἶδες πῶς περίκειμαι* καὶ τοῦ Ὁσίου γ΄, *Δόξα* μεθέορτον, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ὁσίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ὁσίου, *Καὶ νῦν* μεθέορτον· τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ὁσίου, τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

40.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων· εἰς δὲ τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ μεθέορτον· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Στείβει θαλάσσης* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ μεθέορτον *Βαβαὶ τῶν θείων ἔργων σου*. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄ (ὅπου δ’ ἐπισημότερον ἑορτάζεται ὁ Ὅσιος, λέγονται ἀντὶ τῶν μεθεόρτων οἱ Αἶνοι τοῦ Ἁγίου εἰς δ΄). *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

41.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς ἑορτῆς· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον *Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

# Month of January: St. Theodosios the Cenobiarch Concurrence (§ 38–41)

## Commemoration of Our Righteous Father Theodosios the Cenobiarch [Violakis, p. 333]

...his office is chanted together with that of the Afterfeast according to the order of the Menaion; if the feast falls on a Saturday, the Epistle of the Saint [2 Corinthians 4:6–15] and the Gospel of the Saturday after the Lights [Epiphany, Luke 16:10–15] are read.

39.    If the feast falls on the Sunday after the Lights: at Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and Kathisma 1 of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 10 Stichira: 4 Resurrectional, 3 of the Afterfeast: **"Didst thou see how I am invested"** (*Εἶδες πῶς περίκειμαι*), and 3 of the Righteous Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Afterfeast; **"Both now and ever"**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings of the Righteous Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the Afterfeast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Righteous Saint, that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

40.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; at the third Stichologia [Stasis], the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Afterfeast; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, that of the Feast, and that of the Righteous Saint; after the Third Ode, the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the Saints of the day; Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the entire order of the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Righteous Saint, and that of the Afterfeast: **"O the wonder of Thy divine works!"** (*Βαβαὶ τῶν θείων ἔργων σου*). At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast (where the Righteous Saint is celebrated with greater solemnity, instead of the afterfeast stichira, the 4 Praises of the Saint are chanted); **"Glory"**: the appointed Resurrectional Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

41.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes of the Tone for 4 troparia, and 4 from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Feast; after the Little Entrance: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, that of the Righteous Saint, and that of the Holy Patron of the Temple; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); the Epistle of the Righteous Saint [2 Corinthians 4:6–15] and the Gospel of the Sunday after the Lights [Epiphany, Matthew 4:12–17]. At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.[^233]

*(Printed Page 333)*

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights with the Triodion (§ 42–44)

## Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα μετὰ Τριῳδίου [Violakis, p. 334]

*Σημ. Δεῖ γινώσκειν ὅτι τὸ Ἅγιον Πάσχα κατέρχεται μέχρι τῆς ΚΒ΄ τοῦ Μαρτίου μηνός, καὶ ἀνέρχεται μέχρι τῆς ΚΔ΄ τοῦ Ἀπριλίου, ἑπομένως καὶ τὸ Τριῴδιον ἄρχεται κατὰ μὲν τὴν πρώτην περίστασιν, τῇ ΙΑ΄ Ἰανουαρίου, κατὰ δὲ τὴν δευτέραν, τῇ ΙΓ΄ Φεβρουαρίου. Περὶ τούτου ὅρα τὸν Ἑορτοδρόμιον Πίνακα.*

42.    Εἰ τύχοι ἄρχεσθαι τὸ Τριῴδιον τῇ ΙΑ΄ Ἰανουαρίου καὶ συμπέσοι καὶ ἡ Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς ἐφεξῆς. Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ὁσίου Θεοδοσίου γ΄. *Δόξα*, *Παντοκράτορ Κύριε*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ὁσίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ὁσίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου· τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

43.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ· εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς Ὀκτωήχου, εἶτα Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τοῦ Τριῳδίου· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Στείβει θαλάσσης*, εἶτα τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου, τὸ *Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ*, καὶ ψάλλεται ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμός, *Δόξα*, *Τῆς μετανοίας ἄνοιξόν μοι* καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ δύο Τροπάρια, τὸ *Σῶσον ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαόν σου* καὶ ἀκολούθως στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄ (ἐκτὸς ἂν ἐπισήμως ἑορτάζηται ὁ Ἅγιος, ὅτε καὶ λέγονται ἀντὶ τῶν μεθεόρτων Αἶνοι ἐκ τοῦ Ἁγίου). *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

44.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights with the Triodion (§ 42–44)

## Sunday after the Lights with the Triodion [Violakis, p. 335]

*Note: It is necessary to know that Holy Pascha can occur as early as March 22 and as late as April 24; consequently, the period of the Lenten Triodion may begin in the earliest possible instance on January 11, and in the latest possible instance on February 13. Concerning this, see the Paschal Tables [Heortodromion].*

42.    If the period of the Lenten Triodion begins on January 11 and this coincides with the Sunday after the Lights [Epiphany], the office is chanted as follows: at Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and Kathisma 1 of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 10 Stichira: 4 Resurrectional, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 of our Righteous Father Theodosios; **"Glory"**: **"Almighty Lord"** (*Παντοκράτορ Κύριε*); **"Both now and ever"**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings of the Righteous Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the Triodion; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Righteous Saint, that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

43.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata with those of the Afterfeast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and that of the Triodion with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*), and that of the Righteous Saint; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos of the Octoechos, then the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Triodion; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints of the day, and the Synaxarion / Commentary [Hypomnema] of the Triodion; Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*); then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*) and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*); and Psalm 50 [LXX] is chanted; **"Glory"**: **"Open to me the doors of repentance, O Giver of Life"** (*Τῆς μετανοίας ἄνοιξόν μοι πύλας, Ζωοδότα*) and the remaining two penitential troparia [**"Guide me in the paths of salvation"** and **"As I ponder the multitude of evil deeds"**]; the litany: **"Save, O God, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον, ὁ Θεός, τὸν λαόν σου*); and following this we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Righteous Saint, and that of the Triodion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast (unless the Righteous Saint is celebrated with greater solemnity, when the Praises of the Saint are chanted instead of the afterfeast stichira); **"Glory"**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

44.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the festal Canon...[^234]

*(Printed Page 335)*

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights with Triodion (§ 44 concl. – § 47 incipit)

## Ἑορτὴ ἐν Κυριακῇ: Σύμπτωσις μετὰ τοῦ Τριῳδίου [Violakis, p. 336]

εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Τριῳδίου δ΄. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον *Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ Φαρισαίου. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως*, *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

45.    Εἰ τύχοι ἄρχεσθαι τὸ Τριῴδιον τῇ ΙΒ΄ ἢ τῇ ΙΓ΄ τοῦ μηνός, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα καὶ ἡ τοῦ Τριῳδίου ψάλλονται ὡς ἐφεξῆς· Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα γ΄ *Ὕμνον νῦν μεθέορτον* (ὅρα 12 Ἰανουαρίου), *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* μεθέορτον *Ὁρῶσά σε ἡ φύσις ἅπασα*, (ὅρα Δοξαστικὸν τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ἑσπερινοῦ τῆς 12ης Ἰανουαρίου), τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

46.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* ἅπαξ, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ τῆς γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, Κάθισμα τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Στείβει θαλάσσης*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου (ὅρα τὴν διάταξιν ἐν § 43)· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄. *Δόξα*, *Ταῖς ἐξ ἔργων καυχήσεσι*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

47.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Τριῳδίου δ΄. 45.    If the Triodion begins on January 12 or 13, the office of the Sunday after the Lights and that of the Triodion are chanted as follows: On Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrectional Stichira, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 Afterfeast stichira: **"Now let us sing an afterfeast hymn"** (*Ὕμνον νῦν μεθέορτον*, see January 12); **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone; Entrance with censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, that of the Triodion, and that of the Feast; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion with its Ikos, and the Kathisma of the Triodion and the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints of the day, and the Commentary [Synaxarion] of the Triodion; the Katavasiai: **"The Lord traversing the deep"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel appointed for the Sundays of the Triodion (see the order in § 43); then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Triodion, and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 Afterfeast stichira; **"Glory..."**: **"By boasting of works"** (*Ταῖς ἐξ ἔργων καυχήσεσι*); **"Both now and ever..."**: **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

47.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Triodion. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), that of the Holy Patron of the Temple, and the Kontakion: **"Thou didst appear today"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); the Epistle and Gospel of the Triodion [2 Timothy 3:10–15 and Luke 18:10–14]. At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*)...[^235]

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights Concluded (§ 47 concl. – § 48); Epistle & Gospel Notes

## Ἀπόδοσις καὶ Σημειώσεις περὶ Ἀποστόλου καὶ Εὐαγγελίου [Violakis, p. 338]

Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

48.    Εἰ τύχοι ἄρχεσθαι τὸ Τριῴδιον τῇ ΙΔ΄ τοῦ μηνός, ἡ Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς προψάλλεται τῇ ΙΓ΄ ἤτοι τῷ Σαββάτῳ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον λέγεται τοῦ Σαββάτου μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα, ἡ δὲ τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ Φαρισαίου Ἀκολουθία μετὰ τῶν Ἀναστασίμων ψάλλεται ὡς εἴθισται (ὅρα σημ. β΄ ἐν περιπτώσει Β΄ § 16.)

### Σημειώσεις περὶ Ἀποστόλου καὶ Εὐαγγελίου.

Α΄)    Ἐὰν παρέλθῃ ἡ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα Κυριακὴ καὶ μένῃ μία μόνη μέχρι τῆς Α΄ Κυριακῆς τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τῇ Κυριακῇ ταύτῃ Ἀπόστολον λέγομεν τῆς ΛΒ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ζακχαίου.

Β΄)    Ἐὰν μεσολαβῶσι δύο Κυριακαί, τῇ μὲν Α΄ Ἀπόστολον λέγομεν τῆς ΚΘ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ι΄ Λεπρῶν, τῇ δὲ Β΄ Ἀπόστολον λέγομεν τῆς ΛΒ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ζακχαίου.

Γ΄)    Ἐὰν μεσολαβῶσι τρεῖς, τῇ μὲν Α΄ Ἀπόστολον λέγομεν τῆς ΚΘ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ι΄ Λεπρῶν, τῇ δὲ Β΄ Ἀπόστολον τῆς ΛΒ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ζακχαίου, καὶ τῇ Γ΄ Ἀπόστολον τῆς ΙΖ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Χαναναίας.

Δ΄)    Ἐὰν δὲ μεσολαβῶσι τέσσαρες Κυριακαί, τῇ μὲν Α΄ Ἀπόστολον λέγομεν τῆς ΚΘ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ι΄ Λεπρῶν, τῇ δὲ Β΄ Ἀπόστολον τῆς ΛΑ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον Κυριακῆς ΙΓ΄ Λουκᾶ,* τῇ Γ΄ Ἀπόστολον τῆς ΛΒ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ζακχαίου καὶ τῇ Δ΄ Ἀπόστολον τῆς ΙΖ΄ Κυριακῆς καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Χαναναίας.

> *Σημ.* Δεῖ γινώσκειν ὅτι μετὰ τὴν ἀπόδοσιν τῆς ἑορτῆς τῶν Θεοφανείων, ὅταν τὸ Πάσχα ἐστὶν ὄψιμον καὶ ἀποροῦμεν Εὐαγγελίων διὰ τὰς καθ’ ἡμέραν Λειτουργίας μέχρι τῆς ἐνάρξεως τοῦ Τριῳδίου, ἐὰν πληρωθῇ ἡ σειρὰ τῶν Εὐαγγελίων τοῦ Λουκᾶ,

# Month of January: Sunday after the Lights Concluded (§ 47 concl. – § 48); Epistle & Gospel Notes

## Apodosis and Notes Concerning the Epistle and Gospel [Violakis, p. 339]

...Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

48.    If the Triodion begins on the 14th of the month, the Apodosis of the Feast is anticipated and chanted on Saturday the 13th; the Epistle and Gospel of the Saturday after the Lights are read; and the office of the Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee, together with the Sunday Resurrectional hymns, is chanted according to custom (see Note 2 in Situation Two, § 16).

### Notes Concerning the Epistle and Gospel Readings

1.    If after the Sunday after the Lights only one Sunday remains before the First Sunday of the Triodion: on that Sunday we read the Epistle of the 32nd Sunday [1 Timothy 4:9–15] and the Gospel of Zacchaeus [15th Sunday of Luke, Luke 19:1–10].

2.    If two Sundays intervene: on the first we read the Epistle of the 29th Sunday [Colossians 3:4–11] and the Gospel of the Ten Lepers [12th Sunday of Luke, Luke 17:12–19]; and on the second we read the Epistle of the 32nd Sunday [1 Timothy 4:9–15] and the Gospel of Zacchaeus [15th Sunday of Luke, Luke 19:1–10].

3.    If three Sundays intervene: on the first we read the Epistle of the 29th Sunday [Colossians 3:4–11] and the Gospel of the Ten Lepers [12th Sunday of Luke, Luke 17:12–19]; on the second we read the Epistle of the 32nd Sunday [1 Timothy 4:9–15] and the Gospel of Zacchaeus [15th Sunday of Luke, Luke 19:1–10]; and on the third we read the Epistle of the 17th Sunday [2 Corinthians 6:16–7:1] and the Gospel of the Canaanite Woman [17th Sunday of Matthew, Matthew 15:21–28].

4.    If four Sundays intervene: on the first we read the Epistle of the 29th Sunday [Colossians 3:4–11] and the Gospel of the Ten Lepers [12th Sunday of Luke, Luke 17:12–19]; on the second we read the Epistle of the 31st Sunday [1 Timothy 1:15–17] and the Gospel of the 13th Sunday of Luke [The Rich Ruler, Luke 18:18–27]; on the third Sunday we read the Epistle of the 32nd Sunday [1 Timothy 4:9–15] and the Gospel of Zacchaeus [15th Sunday of Luke, Luke 19:1–10]; and on the fourth we read the Epistle of the 17th Sunday [2 Corinthians 6:16–7:1] and the Gospel of the Canaanite Woman [17th Sunday of Matthew, Matthew 15:21–28].

> *Note.* It is necessary to know that after the Apodosis of the Feast of Theophany, when Pascha is late and we lack Gospels for the daily Divine Liturgies until the beginning of the Triodion, if the sequence of the Gospels of Luke has been completed...[^236]

*(Printed Page 339)*

# Month of January: Gospel Note Concluded; Hypapante Katavasiai; St. Anthony the Great (§ 1–3 incipit)

## Presentation Katavasiai and Saint Anthony the Great [Violakis, p. 341]

...we calculate for the current year how many weeks of the Gospel of Saint Matthew remained before the Sunday before the Elevation of the Holy Cross, and we read this sequence until the Triodion begins; we do likewise for the Epistle readings.

5.    After the Apodosis of the Feast of Theophany, on the first occurring Sunday or feast, we begin the Katavasiai of the Meeting of the Lord: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*), and the Kontakion: **"Thou Who didst sanctify the virginal womb by Thy birth"** (*Ὁ μήτραν παρθενικὴν ἁγιάσας τῷ τόκῳ σου*).

### January 17: Our Righteous Father Anthony the Great

1.    If the commemoration of the Righteous Saint falls on any day except Sunday: his office is chanted as appointed in the Menaion.

2.    If it falls on Sunday: on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 6 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Righteous Saint; **"Glory..."**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saint [Wisdom 3:1–9; Wisdom 5:15–6:3; Wisdom 4:7–15]. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever..."**: **"O Virgin Unwedded"** (*Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε*); the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Righteous Saint: **"Emulating the zealous Elijah in thy ways"** (*Ζηλωτὴν Ἠλίαν*), the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the Righteous Saint, and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Righteous Saint, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata in sequence, and at the third Kathisma [Stichologia] that of the Righteous Saint with its Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and that of the Righteous Saint; after the Third Ode, the Kontakion and Kathisma of the Righteous Saint, and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion; the Katavasiai: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Righteous Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Righteous Saint...[^237]

δ΄.    *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

# Month of January: St. Anthony Note Concluded; SS. Athanasius & Cyril (§ 1–4)

## Ἅγιοι Ἀθανάσιος καὶ Κύριλλος [Violakis, p. 344]

Φαρισαίου μέχρι τοῦ Σαββάτου τῆς αὐτῆς ἑβδομάδος. (Ὅρα τὸν τοῦ Ἑορτοδρομίου Πίνακα).

### Τῇ ΙΗ΄. Τῶν ἐν ἁγίοις πατέρων ἡμῶν Ἀθανασίου καὶ Κυρίλλου Πατριαρχῶν Ἀλεξανδρείας.

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τῶν Ἁγίων ἐν ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία αὐτῶν ψάλλεται ὡς ἐστι διατεταγμένη ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ.

2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ ἄνευ Τριῳδίου, ἡ Ἀκολουθία αὐτῶν ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Κυριακῇ τυπικὴν Διάταξιν τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ ἁγίου Ἀντωνίου ὅρα § 2, 3, 4.

3.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ μετὰ Τριῳδίου, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄. *Δόξα*, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τῶν Ἁγίων, *Καὶ νῦν* τοῦ Τριῳδίου· τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἁγίων, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

4.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ ἡ Λιτὴ τῶν Ἁγίων, τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὸ τῆς γ΄ Στιχολογίας τῶν Ἁγίων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ οἱ τῶν Ἁγίων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄ τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων γ΄. *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*. Ἐν τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ ψάλλονται τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Τριῳδίου ἕτερα δ΄. Ἀπόστολος τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*

*(Printed Page 344)*

=== LEAF p360 ===

# Month of January: St. Anthony Note Concluded; SS. Athanasius & Cyril (§ 1–4)

## Saints Athanasius and Cyril of Alexandria [Violakis, p. 345]

...until Saturday of that week (see the Paschal Tables [Heortodromion]).

### January 18: Our Fathers among the Saints Athanasius and Cyril, Patriarchs of Alexandria

1.    If the commemoration of the Saints falls on any day except Sunday: their office is chanted as appointed in the Menaion.

2.    If it falls on Sunday outside the Triodion: their office is chanted according to the Sunday rubrical order of the feast of Saint Anthony (see § 2, 3, and 4).

3.    If it falls on Sunday within the Triodion: on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrectional Stichira, 2 of the Triodion, and 4 of the Saints; **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Saints; **"Both now and ever..."**: of the Triodion; the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saints: **"Shining forth with deeds of orthodoxy"** (*Ἔργοις ἐκλάμψαντες ὀρθοδοξίας*), the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

4.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the Saints, and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Hypakoe of the Tone, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata in sequence, and at the third Kathisma [Stichologia] that of the Saints with its Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, that of the Triodion, and that of the Saints; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, then the Kathisma of the Triodion, that of the Saints, and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints, and the Commentary [Synaxarion] of the Triodion; the Katavasiai: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel appointed for the Sundays of the Triodion; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Triodion, that of the Saints, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 3 Resurrectional Stichira, 2 of the Triodion, and 3 of the Saints; **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). In the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 other hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Triodion. The Epistle of the Saints [Hebrews 13:7–16] and the Gospel of the Sunday [Luke 18:10–14]; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.[^239]

*(Printed Page 345)*

# Month of January: St. Euthymius the Great; St. Gregory the Theologian (§ 1 – § 2 incipit)

## Τῇ Κ΄: Μνήμη τοῦ Ὁσίου πατρὸς ἡμῶν Εὐθυμίου τοῦ Μεγάλου [Violakis, p. 346]

καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

> *Σημ.* Ὅτι ἡ μνήμη τῶν Ἁγίων τούτων δυνατὸν νὰ συμπέσῃ ἐν τῷ Τριῳδίῳ ἀπὸ τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ Φαρισαίου, μέχρι τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Ἀσώτου (Ὅρα τὸν τοῦ Ἑορτοδρομίου Πίνακα).

### Τῇ Κ΄. Μνήμη τοῦ Ὁσίου πατρὸς ἡμῶν Εὐθυμίου τοῦ Μεγάλου

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ὁσίου ἐν ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἢ ἐν Κυριακῇ μετὰ ἢ ἄνευ Τριῳδίου, τὴν διάταξιν τῆς Ἀκολουθίας ὅρα ἐν τῇ μνήμῃ τοῦ ἁγίου Ἀντωνίου § 1, 6.

> *Σημ.* Ἀξιοσημείωτός ἐστιν ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ εἰς τὸν ἅγιον Εὐθύμιον α΄ Κανόνος, ποιηθέντος ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου τοῦ Δαμασκηνοῦ· διότι τούτου τοῦ Εἱρμοῦ ἡ ἀρχὴ ἐν ταῖς μεταγενεστέραις ἐκδόσεσι πανταχοῦ ἀπαντᾶται οὕτω· *Παῖδας εὐαγεῖς ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ*, ἐν δὲ τῷ Κανόνι τούτῳ ἡ Ἀκροστιχὶς τοῦ Κανόνος *Ὄλβος πέφηνας γηγενῶν Εὐθύμιε* ἀπαιτεῖ τὸν τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς Εἱρμὸν ἄρχεσθαι ἀπὸ τοῦ Υ καὶ ἐν τοῖς κατὰ τὸ ,αφλγ΄ ἔτος ἐν Βενετίᾳ ἐκδοθεῖσι Μηναίοις ὑπὸ Στεφάνου Σαβίου, ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς ἄρχεται ἀπὸ τοῦ Υ οὕτως *Υἱοὺς τῆς Σιὼν ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ* συμφώνως πρὸς τὴν Ἀκροστιχίδα, ἐξ οὗ δῆλον ὅτι αὕτη ἦν ἴσως ἡ ἀρχαία καὶ γνησία τοῦ Εἱρμοῦ τούτου ἀρχή· (Γνώμη τοῦ ἀοιδίμου Πατριάρχου Κωνσταντινουπόλεως Κωνσταντίου τοῦ Α΄).

### Τῇ ΚΕ΄. Τοῦ ἐν Ἁγίοις πατρὸς ἡμῶν Γρηγορίου τοῦ Θεολόγου

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ἁγίου ἐν ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία αὐτοῦ ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν, ἐξαιρουμένων τῶν δευτέρων ἑσπερίων Στιχηρῶν, δι’ ἃ ὅρα τὴν ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ ἁγίου Νικολάου ὑποσημείωσιν.
2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ ἄνευ Τριῳδίου, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, *Δόξα*, *Ἡ γρήγορος γλῶσσά σου*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου *Τὰς καρδίας τῶν πιστῶν*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε*.

*(Printed Page 346)*

# Month of January: St. Euthymius the Great; St. Gregory the Theologian (§ 1 – § 2 incipit)

## January 20 & 25: Commemorations of Euthymius the Great and Gregory the Theologian [Violakis, p. 347]

...and Dismissal.

> *Note.* The commemoration of these Saints {our Holy Fathers the Great Athanasius and Cyril, Patriarchs of Alexandria} may occur in the Triodion from the Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee until the Sunday of the Prodigal Son (see the Paschal Tables [Heortodromion]).

### January 20: Commemoration of Our Venerable Father Euthymius the Great

1.    If the commemoration of the Venerable Father occurs on any day except Sunday, or on Sunday with or without the Triodion, see the order of service in the commemoration of Saint Anthony, §§ 1, 6.

> *Note.* Worthy of note is the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode of the First Canon to Saint Euthymius, composed by Saint John of Damascus; for in later editions the beginning of this Heirmos is everywhere found thus: **"The holy Children in the furnace"** (*Παῖδας εὐαγεῖς ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ*); whereas in this Canon the Acrostic **"A wealth to mortals hast thou appeared, O Euthymius"** (*Ὄλβος πέφηνας γηγενῶν Εὐθύμιε*) requires the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode to begin with the letter *Y* [Upsilon]; and in the Menaia published in Venice in the year 1533 by Stephanos Savios, the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode begins with *Y* thus: **"Sons of Zion in the furnace"** (*Υἱοὺς τῆς Σιὼν ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ*), in accordance with the Acrostic, from which it is evident that this was perhaps the ancient and genuine beginning of this Heirmos (opinion of the ever-memorable Patriarch of Constantinople Constantius I).

### January 25: Commemoration of Our Father among the Saints Gregory the Theologian

1.    If the commemoration of the Saint occurs on any day except Sunday, his office is chanted according to the order of the Menaion, with the exception of the second set of Stichira Prosomia, concerning which see the note in the Vespers of the Feast of Saint Nicholas [December 6].
2.    If it occurs on Sunday outside the Triodion: on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 6 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Saint; **"Glory..."**: **"Thy watchful tongue"** (*Ἡ γρήγορος γλῶσσά σου*); **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone; Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Saint: **"The hearts of the faithful"** (*Τὰς καρδίας τῶν πιστῶν*); **"Both now and ever..."**: **"O Virgin Unwedded"** (*Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε*)...[^240]

*(Printed Page 347)*

# Month of January: St. Gregory the Theologian (§ 2 concl. – § 6 incipit)

## Τῇ ΚΕ΄: Τοῦ ἐν Ἁγίοις πατρὸς ἡμῶν Γρηγορίου τοῦ Θεολόγου (Συνέχεια) [Violakis, p. 348]

ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου *Ὁ ποιμενικὸς αὐλός*, Θεοτοκίον *Τοῦ Γαβριὴλ φθεγξαμένου* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὸ τῆς γ΄ Στιχολογίας Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

4.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ α΄ Κανόνος τοῦ Ἁγίου. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ μήτραν παρθενικήν*, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως*, *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

5.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ μετὰ Τριῳδίου, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ α΄ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄ (τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Ἀπόκρεω τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄), *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

6.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τοῦ Τριῳδίου (ἐὰν ᾖ ἡ Κυριακὴ τῆς Ἀπόκρεω) εἰδὲ μή, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν

*(Printed Page 348)*

=== LEAF p364 ===

# Month of January: St. Gregory the Theologian (§ 2 concl. – § 6 incipit)

## January 25: Commemoration of Gregory the Theologian (Continued) [Violakis, p. 349]

...the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, of the Saint: **"The pastoral flute"** (*Ὁ ποιμενικὸς αὐλός*), Theotokion: **"When Gabriel cried aloud"** (*Τοῦ Γαβριὴλ φθεγξαμένου*), and Dismissal.

3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the Saint, and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata in sequence, and at the third Kathisma [Stichologia] that of the Saint with its Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and that of the Saint; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion with its Ikos, then the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Menologion; the Katavasiai: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Saint; **"Glory..."**: of the Saint (*Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου*); **"Both now and ever..."**: **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

4.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the First Canon of the Saint. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, that of the Holy Patron of the Temple, and the Kontakion: **"Thou Who didst sanctify the virginal womb by Thy birth"** (*Ὁ μήτραν παρθενικὴν ἁγιάσας τῷ τόκῳ σου*); the Epistle of the Saint [Hebrews 7:26–8:2] and the Gospel of the Sunday; at **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

5.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs on Sunday within the Triodion period: on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the first Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrectional Stichira, 2 of the Triodion, and 4 of the Saint (on the Sunday of Meatfare: 3 of the Triodion and 3 of the Saint); **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone; Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever..."**: of the Triodion; the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

6.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the Saint; **"Glory..."**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever..."**: of the Triodion (if it is Meatfare Sunday); otherwise, **"Both now and ever..."**: the Theotokion; the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata in sequence, and at the third...[^241]

*(Printed Page 349)*

# Month of January: St. Gregory the Theologian (§ 6 concl. – § 7; Patriarchal Decrees incipit)

## Τῇ ΚΕ΄: Τοῦ ἐν Ἁγίοις πατρὸς ἡμῶν Γρηγορίου τοῦ Θεολόγου (Συνέχεια) [Violakis, p. 350]

Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὸ τῆς γ΄ Στιχολογίας Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ γ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. (Τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Ἀπόκρεω Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄). *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

7.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ μήτραν παρθενικήν*, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως*, *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

> *Σημ.* Ὅτι ἐν πάσαις ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ (ἐκτὸς τῶν Δεσποτικῶν καὶ Θεομητορικῶν ἑορτῶν, τῶν Κυριακῶν τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου, ἔτι δὲ καὶ τοῦ τιμίου Προδρόμου, τῶν κατὰ τὴν ΚΘ΄ Ἰουνίου Πρωτοκορυφαίων Ἀποστόλων καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων Πατέρων κατὰ Ἰούλιον καὶ Ὀκτώβριον) τυπικῷ κανόνι καθώρισται τὸ ψάλλειν εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, πᾶσι τοῖς ἐκκλησιαστικοῖς τοῦτο δῆλον. Ἐπειδὴ δὲ καὶ ἡ μνήμη τῶν θείων Πατέρων Γρηγορίου τοῦ Θεολόγου καὶ Ἰωάννου τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου συμπίπτει καὶ Κυριακῇ, ὡς ὄφλημα δίκαιον καὶ πρέπον λελόγισται πρὸς τηλικούτους ἱεροὺς ἄνδρας, τοὺς πάσῃ σοφίᾳ, ἀρετῇ καὶ χάριτι τῇ ποιμαντικῇ διαπρέψαντας ἐπιστασίᾳ καὶ πόνοις μεγάλοις τὸ τῆς Βυζαντίου Ἐκκλησίας ἰθύναντας πνευματικὸν σκάφος, οὐ μὴν ἀλλὰ καὶ δι’ ὧν κατέλιπον πανσόφων, μελιῤῥύτων καὶ ἀθανάτων συγγραμμάτων, τὴν Οἰκουμενικὴν μίαν, καὶ ἁγίαν Ἐκκλησίαν φαιδρύναντας, προσῆκον φαμεν οἰκεῖον, καὶ παντὶ λόγῳ δικαίου ἐποφειλόμενον ἤγηται, ἐπὶ συμπτώσει τῆς σεπτῆς αὐτῶν μνήμης ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Κυριακῇ ἀντὶ τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ, *Δόξα*, εἰς

> 3. *Ἀλλ’ ὅταν ἡ μνήμη αὐτῶν συμπέσῃ Κυριακῇ ἐντὸς τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τότε Δόξα τῶν Αἴνων ψάλλεται τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου.*

*(Printed Page 350)*

# Month of January: St. Gregory the Theologian (§ 6 concl. – § 7; Patriarchal Decrees incipit)

## January 25: Commemoration of Gregory the Theologian (Concluded) [Violakis, p. 351]

...Kathisma [Stichologia] that of the Saint with the Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, that of the Triodion, and that of the Saint. After the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion with its Ikos, then the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saint, and the Commentary [Synaxarion] of the Sunday; the Katavasiai: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel appointed for the Sundays of the Triodion; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 3 Resurrectional Stichira, 2 of the Triodion, and 3 of the Saint (on the Sunday of Meatfare: 3 Resurrectional Stichira, 2 of the Triodion, and 3 of the Saint); **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

7.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Triodion. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, that of the Holy Patron of the Temple, and the Kontakion: **"Thou Who didst sanctify the virginal womb by Thy birth"** (*Ὁ μήτραν παρθενικὴν ἁγιάσας τῷ τόκῳ σου*); the Epistle of the Saint and the Gospel of the Sunday; at **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

> *Note.* In all the Sundays of the year (except those of the Feasts of the Lord or the Theotokos, the Sundays of the Triodion and the Pentecostarion, and also those of the Precious Forerunner [September 23 / May 25 / August 29], the Chief Apostles Peter and Paul [June 29], and the Holy Fathers of the Councils [July and October]), the rubrical canon prescribes that at the Praises we chant the Resurrectional Eothinon at **"Glory..."**; this is manifest to all churchmen. Since, however, the commemoration of the divine Fathers Gregory the Theologian and John Chrysostom may also coincide with a Sunday, it has been judged a just and meet obligation toward such great sacred men—who shone forth in all wisdom, virtue, and pastoral grace, and who with great labors guided the spiritual ship of the Byzantine Church, and moreover, through the all-wise, honey-flowing, and immortal writings which they bequeathed, illumined the one, holy, and Catholic Church—we say that it is fitting and by every reason of justice due, that upon the occurrence of their venerable memory on a Sunday, instead of the Eothinon, we chant at the Praises the Doxastikon of these Luminaries, and this above all in the Great Church of Christ, whose throne both of them illumined by their renown (opinion of the ever-memorable Patriarch of Constantinople Constantine I, the Byzantine).

> *Note on Footnote 3.* However, when this commemoration falls on a Sunday within the Triodion period, then at the Praises the Doxastikon chanted at **"Glory..."** is that of the Triodion.[^242]

*(Printed Page 351)*
